/bin/bash -lc "set -o pipefail
samtools view inputs/pooled.infer.donors.q1.bam | head -100000 | python3 -c '
import sys,re
from collections import Counter
cb=Counter(); bc=Counter(); cr=Counter(); tag_names=Counter()
n=0
for line in sys.stdin:
    parts=line.rstrip(\"\\n\").split(\"\\t\")
    n+=1
    for f in parts[11:]:
        if \":\" in f:
            tag=f[:f.index(\":\")]
            tag_names[tag]+=1
    # exact CB, BC, CR values after first two colon-separated segments
    for tag in [\"CB\",\"BC\",\"CR\"]:
        for f in parts[11:]:
            if f.startswith(tag+\":\"):
                # value is everything after second colon
                idx=f.find(\":\", f.find(\":\")+1)
                val=f[idx+1:] if idx>=0 else \"\"
                if tag==\"CB\": cb[val]+=1
                elif tag==\"BC\": bc[val]+=1
                else: cr[val]+=1
                break
print(\"n\",n)
print(\"tag_names\",tag_names)
print(\"unique CB\",len(cb),cb.most_common(20))
print(\"unique BC\",len(bc),bc.most_common(30))
print(\"unique CR\",len(cr),cr.most_common(20))
'"
